title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (GEN AI) -Pune/Hyd
jobDescription:
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer with deep expertise in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Generative AI, and cloud-native ML systems. This role is ideal for someone who has built production-ready intent detection models, NLG systems, and has strong experience with AWS Bedrock, LangChain, and LangGraph. Youll play a key role in architecting and scaling AI-first applications that leverage the latest in LLM, orchestration, and AWS-native services.
Key Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and deploy intent classification and intent detection models using LLMs and traditional NLP methods.
• Build and optimize Natural Language Generation (NLG) pipelines for chatbot responses, summarization, content creation, or knowledge grounding.
• Architect and implement LangChain and LangGraph based applications for LLM-driven workflows (e.g., autonomous agents, RAG systems).
• Develop scalable machine learning pipelines using the AWS tech stack (e.g., Sagemaker, Lambda, Bedrock, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Athena).
• Integrate and fine-tune foundation models via AWS Bedrock, including Amazon Titan, Anthropic Claude, or Meta Llama.
• Collaborate closely with product managers, ML researchers, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into robust AI solutions.
• Lead experimentation efforts, conduct A/B testing, and ensure continuous evaluation of deployed ML models.
• Mentor junior ML engineers and contribute to best practices in MLOps, model governance, and responsible AI.
Required Qualifications:
• Total 10+ in IT with 4 to 5 + years of experience in machine learning, with a focus on NLP and Generative AI.
• Strong experience building and deploying intent detection, text classification, sequence tagging, and entity recognition models.
• Proficient in LangChain, LangGraph, vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone), and orchestration of LLM workflows.
• Deep knowledge of AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Lambda, DynamoDB, Step Functions, etc.
• Experience working with open-source LLMs (LLaMA, Mistral, Falcon) or commercial APIs (Claude, GPT-4, etc.).
• Proficient in Python, with a solid grasp of ML frameworks such as PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers, scikit-learn.
• Strong understanding of MLOps practices including model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, and auto-scaling.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

Nice to Have:
• Experience integrating RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems at scale.
• Familiarity with vector search using Amazon OpenSearch, Pinecone, or Weaviate.
• Experience with streaming data processing (e.g., AWS Kinesis, Kafka).
• Contributions to open-source AI/ML or NLP projects.

We are seeking a deeply technical, hands-on Data Science leader with over 15 years of experience to spearhead complex predictive modeling, advanced analytics, and machine learning initiatives. The ideal

candidate must have a strong foundational background as an expert Data Science practitioner who has evolved into a strategic leader.


While rooted heavily in classical Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and statistical modelling, you will also integrate modern Generative AI capabilities into the core data science toolkit. In this role, you will lead

title: AI Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description

Role Overview

We are looking for a deeply hands-on AI professional to design, build, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions across the Manufacturing & Quality value chain. The role spans Generative AI, applied AI engineering, and enterprise data & knowledge platforms, with end-to-end ownership from architecture to production. 

This is a builder role. Screening will emphasize demonstrable, hands-on delivery of production Generative AI systems not slideware or PoCs.


Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Design & Delivery

  • Design and develop end-to-end Generative AI applications for enterprise use cases such as document intelligence, knowledge assistants, and workflow automation.
  • Build production-grade RAG pipelines with strong grounding, evaluation, and observability.
  • Develop agentic AI workflows and multi-agent systems for complex reasoning and orchestration tasks.
  • Build multimodal AI solutions capable of processing text, PDFs, tables, images, and scanned documents.

Architecture & Engineering

  • Own end-to-end solution architecture: data ingestion, model layer, orchestration, APIs, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Build scalable backend APIs and microservices in Python (FastAPI) with clean, testable, well-documented code.
  • Deploy and maintain AI solutions on cloud-native infrastructure (GCP preferred; AWS/Azure acceptable) using containers and CI/CD.
  • Implement MLOps/LLMOps practices versioning, monitoring, cost governance, and rollback safety.

Evaluation, Governance & Compliance

  • Design AI evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, groundedness, faithfulness, hallucination control, and bias.
  • Instrument Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) gates and audit-ready logs suitable for regulated environments.
  • Align outputs with data integrity, GxP, and enterprise security requirements.

Collaboration, Ownership & Innovation

  • Partner with the Principal Product Manager, Principal Data Scientist, business SMEs, and cloud partners to translate requirements into production-ready systems.
  • Assimilate detailed project skill files, PRDs, and technical specs shared for different initiatives, and rapidly convert them into working solutions.
  • Bring fresh ideas and challenge existing designs with data-backed recommendations.
  • Mentor junior team members and interns; contribute to internal AI best practices.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field from a reputed institute.

Experience

  • 4 to 7 years overall in AI Engineering / Data Science / ML.
  • At least 2 to 3 years of hands-on, production-grade LLM / Generative AI development building, deploying, and maintaining real systems (not prototypes).
  • Remaining experience in strong software engineering or applied ML delivery is acceptable.

Must-Have Skills (Hands-on, Production-grade)

Generative AI

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs such as GPT, Gemini, or Anthropic models, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chunking strategies, embeddings, vector stores, and re-ranking, deployed in production.
  • Prompt engineering and prompt versioning discipline.
  • LLM evaluation frameworks and metrics (groundedness, faithfulness, coverage, hallucination).

Programming & Engineering

  • Python (Advanced) production code, testing, packaging, and performance tuning.
  • SQL analytical queries on modern warehouses.
  • FastAPI (or Django) for backend service development.
  • Firebase (or equivalent), Git, REST APIs, Docker, CI/CD basics, and Linux.

Cloud & Delivery

  • Production experience on at least one of GCP, AWS, or Azure; comfort with IAM, storage, compute, and managed AI services.
  • Strong software engineering and system design skills, with proof of taking AI systems from prototype to production with defined SLAs.

Good-to-Have Skills

Advanced AI / GenAI

  • Building agents on existing agent platforms (e.g., Vertex AI Agent Builder, Copilot Studio, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent).
  • Multi-agent orchestration for complex enterprise workflows.
  • Multimodal AI (text + images + tables + scanned documents) and document AI (OCR, layout models, hierarchical extraction).
  • Fine-tuning, distillation, or adapter-based customization of LLMs.

Enterprise Data & Knowledge Platforms

  • Exposure to designing or contributing to enterprise data & knowledge platforms — canonical data models, semantic layers, or knowledge graphs that power multiple downstream AI applications.
  • Familiarity with graph databases (Neo4j, AuraDB, or similar) and knowledge-graph patterns.
  • Modern data stack experience: BigQuery, dbt, and workflow orchestrators such as Airflow or Cloud Composer.

Job Overview

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI & ML Data Collection, you will play a critical role in building and scaling the companys Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform, enabling standardized, reliable, and scalable machine learning capabilities across the organization. This role will focus on transforming existing AI/ML and LLM-driven data systems into a cohesive platform that supports data pipelines, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment.

This position requires deep hands-on expertise in machine learning engineering, LLM-based systems, ML platform development, and MLOps. You will be deeply involved in the design, development, and operationalization of platform components, including data ingestion, feature management, model training and evaluation, scalable inference systems, and model observability capabilities.

You will help ensure that AI/ML systems are production-ready, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient, with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, governance, and developer productivity. You will leverage your expertise in areas such as large language models (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and ML Operations (MLOps).

You will contribute to the end-to-end lifecycle of ML systems, from experimentation and prototyping to deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement while mentoring engineers and promoting strong engineering practices across the team.

Team Overview

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers responsible for building and maintaining the Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform. The team focuses on developing scalable systems that support data pipelines, model lifecycle management, LLM-based workflows, and evaluation frameworks, enabling downstream teams to build and deploy AI-driven data collection solutions.

  • AI-Powered Data Collection Systems: Design and develop scalable AI-driven data collection and enrichment workflows across structured and unstructured data sources.

  • Scalable Platform Engineering: Design distributed, event-driven, and cloud-native systems using asynchronous processing, message queues, containerization, and orchestration patterns to support high-volume workloads.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies, LLM frameworks, orchestration tools, vector databases, and model deployment approaches to improve automation capabilities and developer productivity.
  • Company Values: Model company values and contribute to a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

title: Sr DevOps Engineer, IT - Data Operations Engineering
jobDescription:
Innovation starts from the heart. At Edwards Lifesciences, we are dedicated to developing ground-breaking technologies with a genuine impact on patients lives. At the core of this commitment is our investment in cutting-edge information technology, enabling our global teams to collaborate, operate efficiently, and advance our patient-focused mission.

As part of our IT team, your expertise and commitment will help build and operate the platforms that power Edwards global data and analytics solutions. We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to support Data Operations Engineering and own the operational backbone of our data platforms, including infrastructure as code, continuous integration and delivery, data quality monitoring and incident response, observability, security operations, and cloud cost optimization. Our multi-cloud estate includes Databrick s and Snowflake, with data services moving to Azure while AWS continues to host corporate source systems.

How you will make an impact

  • Build and maintain modular Terraform components that provision cloud and Databricks platform capabilities, including workspaces, cluster policies, secret scopes, networking, and Unity Catalog storage credentials and external locations, consistently across environments and clouds.

  • Design and operate automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines that deploy data platform code and infrastructure through development, staging, and production with approval gates and controlled promotion.

  • Monitor data quality and pipeline health, own first-line response to production alerts, resolve issues directly where possible, and escalate only when the root cause requires deeper pipeline or platform change.

  • Build, test, and continuously improve runbooks for recurring failure modes, automating remediation when the response can be made safe and repeatable.

  • Apply AI- and agent-assisted operations capabilities to accelerate detection, triage, and remediation as those capabilities mature.

  • Build end-to-end observability across Databricks, Snowflake, and orchestration services by bringing platform and execution metadata into unified dashboards, alerting, and pipeline service-level monitoring.

  • Containerize and operate platform workloads, orchestration, and CI runners on Docker and Kubernetes across EKS and AKS.

  • Operate and re-host Apache Airflow, consolidating self-managed instances onto Kubernetes or a managed runtime, while supporting migration of legacy build tooling to GitLab CI.

  • Embed security operations into the platform lifecycle through secrets management, short-lived credentials, least-privilege access, encryption key policies, audit logging, and vulnerability remediation.

  • Drive cloud cost optimization through cost attribution, policy enforcement, right-sizing, tagging standards, and anomaly alerting.

  • Support secure cross-cloud connectivity and data movement between AWS-resident source systems and the Azure data platform.

  • Identify opportunities for automation, reusable standards, reliability improvement, and technical debt reduction, and provide technical guidance to team members.

What you will need (Required)

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or cloud infrastructure roles.

  • Strong hands-on experience administering and automating workloads on both Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure, including identity, networking, and storage services.

  • Demonstrated expertise building modular, reusable infrastructure with Terraform across multiple environments.

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI or an equivalent platform, including environment promotion, approval gates, and secrets handling.

  • Strong proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes, including EKS or AKS and running CI/CD or orchestration workloads on Kubernetes.

  • Hands-on experience operating Apache Airflow, including DAG deployment, scheduling, retries, backfills, pools, and failure recovery.

  • Solid Linux systems administration, shell scripting, and troubleshooting skills.

  • Hands-on experience implementing metrics, logging, dashboards, and alerting using tools such as Datadog or Grafana.

  • Demonstrated experience monitoring pipeline and data quality, owning first-line triage of production alerts, and writing and executing runbooks for recurring failures.

  • Working knowledge of secrets management, least-privilege access control, encryption key management, audit logging, and vulnerability remediation.

  • Working knowledge of cloud cost monitoring, attribution, tagging standards, and right-sizing practices.

  • Proficiency in Python or another scripting language used for automation and tooling.

  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to work across cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to quality, controls, and long-term outcomes.

  • Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

What else we look for (Preferred)

  • Experience operating Databricks or Snowflake, including platform administration, policy management, and service principal or access management.

  • Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles, Unity Catalog, the Databricks Terraform provider, or managed Terraform state and gated production applies.

  • Experience with keyless authentication from CI, such as OIDC-based role assumption or IRSA.

  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Entra ID, or AWS Glue, Athena, Lambda, and Secrets Manager.

  • Experience migrating CI/CD from Jenkins or another legacy build platform.

  • Experience with streaming or change data capture technologies such as AWS DMS, Amazon MSK, or Kafka.

  • Experience with SALT, Ansible, Azure DevOps, or related configuration and delivery tooling.

  • Relevant experience in medical device , pharmaceuticals, or another highly regulated environment, including validation and change control expectations.

Additional information

  • Develops solutions to a variety of complex platform and operational problems and exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques after considering risk and alternatives.

We are looking for an experienced Azure Databricks Administrator to manage, operate, and optimize Azure Databricks platforms within an enterprise Azure ecosystem. The role is responsible for ensuring high availability, security, performance, and cost optimization of Azure Databricks environments while supporting data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML workloads.

Job Purpose


We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled individual to lead the Model Validation function with Risk Management Group. The successful candidate will be responsible for independently validating a diverse range of credit risk models used across both wholesale and retail banking businesses. This role involves assessing model design, data quality, implementation, and ongoing performance to ensure models are fit for purpose, compliant with regulatory requirements, and effectively manage financial risk.

Key Accountabilities


  • Independent Model Validation: Conduct end-to-end independent validation of credit risk models, including but not limited to:
  • Wholesale Banking Models: PD, LGD, EAD models for corporate, commercial real estate, and other institutional exposures; stress testing models; counterparty credit risk models; credit rating models
  • Retail Banking Models: PD, LGD, EAD models for mortgages, auto loans, credit cards, personal loans; application scorecards, behavioral scorecards, collections models.
  • Methodology Review: Critically evaluate model development methodologies, underlying assumptions, conceptual soundness, and quantitative techniques.
  • Data Quality Assessment: Assess the quality, completeness, and appropriateness of data used in model development and ongoing monitoring.
  • Implementation Review: Verify the accurate and robust implementation of models within relevant systems.

  • Governance and Policy: Establish Governance processes and Model validation Policy in line with local regulatory and group requirements.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and modern Python frameworks.
  • Strong experience building production-grade web applications and APIs using technologies such as FastAPI, Flask, Node.js/Express, React.js, or Next.js.
  • Practical experience building applications using Generative AI and LLMs.
  • Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, LLM orchestration, RAG, tool calling, and multi-agent workflows.
  • Experience with one or more AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent.

  • Experience with REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous processing, and distributed application architectures.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform, preferably Azure or AWS.

  • Strong understanding of Git, Agile development, testing, debugging, and software engineering best practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with LLM evaluation, AI observability, prompt evaluation, and model performance monitoring.
  • Experience with fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, Hugging Face Transformers, or model adaptation techniques.

What Success Looks Like

Mandatory Technical Requirements — Hard Screening

1. Java and Backend Engineering

  • Demonstrable responsibility for applications or workloads running in production.
  • Experience with monitoring, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, reliability and performance improvement.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobDescription:
About The Role


DexCare is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build the AI systems behind our products. Your primary focus will be Optimize AI, which ingests, structures, and governs complex healthcare scheduling rules and institutional knowledge into a single, verified source of truth. The core problem is turning large volumes of messy, inconsistent, and constantly changing operational knowledge into structured knowledge that people and AI agents can rely on to make decisions.


This is a hands-on, mid-level role. You will build, ship, and own production ML and LLM systems, working closely with product, engineering, and data teams. Our AI products share a common foundation, so you will also work across them, including Mila, our patient-facing agents, as priorities shift. You will join a well-established team early in the build-out of DexCares AI capabilities, with large health systems already using our products. If you enjoy taking ML systems from prototype to production and making them accurate, reliable, and fast, we’d love to hear from you.


What You’ll Do

  • Build systems that ingest unstructured and inconsistent source material, such as policies, protocols, rules, and spreadsheets, and turn it into structured, versioned, and verified knowledge.
  • Build extraction, normalization, and validation pipelines using LLMs and classical techniques; detect conflicts, gaps, and stale information, and route uncertain cases to human review.
  • Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that give downstream systems and agents accurate, grounded, and traceable answers with low latency.
  • Build, ship, and maintain components of the agentic systems that act on this knowledge, including orchestration, tool calling, and state management.
  • Build evaluation for the systems you ship: ground-truth datasets, accuracy metrics, regression tests that run before every release, LLM-as-judge and human review, and monitoring of quality in production.
  • Diagnose and improve accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost of ML systems in production.
  • Build components that can be reused across DexCare’s AI products, and contribute to other products as priorities shift.
  • Follow ML lifecycle best practices: versioning of models, prompts, datasets, and knowledge; deployment; monitoring; and retraining.
  • Handle patient and customer data in line with HIPAA and DexCare’s privacy and security standards.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning or software engineering, including building and running production ML systems.
  • Experience building systems that extract, structure, and verify knowledge from unstructured sources, such as documents, policies, or operational data, with measurable accuracy.
  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM-based agentic systems to production, including orchestration, tool calling, and handling failures with retries and fallbacks.
  • Experience building retrieval systems and improving their accuracy and latency.
  • Experience evaluating ML and LLM systems: building eval datasets, defining metrics, and using the results to decide what ships.
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, code review, and API design.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices and at least one major cloud platform.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work across product, engineering, and data teams, including across time zones.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous problem spaces where requirements and data evolve.

Preferred

  • Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Google ADK.
  • Experience with Azure / AWS and their ML and AI services.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs, rules engines, or other structured knowledge representations.
  • Experience with predictive ML or optimization for problems such as forecasting, scheduling, ranking, or matching.
  • Experience with guardrails, safety classifiers, or red-teaming for LLM applications.
  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, including handling PHI under HIPAA.

The successful candidate will partner closely with global business technology leaders to deliver customer-centric solutions, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen the bank's digital capabilities.

Technology and Engineering Leadership

  • Drive engineering productivity through modern tools, automation, AI-assisted development, and platform standardization.

Talent Strategy & Organizational Development

  • Lead talent acquisition, workforce planning, succession planning, and leadership development programs.
  • Mentor and coach senior technology leaders while building a robust leadership pipeline.
  • Drive transformation from contractor-heavy teams toward a strategically balanced permanent workforce model.
  • Build a culture of learning, innovation, inclusion, and continuous professional development.


GCC and Executive Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary technology leader for India supporting global Consumer Banking, Business Banking, and Digital executives.
  • Play a key role in the expansion and maturation of the GCC as a strategic technology center.
  • Build trusted relationships with CBB CIO and Technology leadership, Business Leaders, Product Leaders, Risk Partners, and Operations stakeholders.
  • Influence strategic decisions through data, technology insights, and strong business partnership.
  • Communicate effectively with executive leadership regarding strategy, delivery performance, technology risk, and transformation progress.
  • Drive outcomes through collaboration and influence across highly matrixed global organizations.


Risk, Security & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure technology solutions comply with regulatory requirements, enterprise standards, and risk management frameworks.
  • Partner closely with Information Security, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Audit teams.
  • Strengthen resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational readiness capabilities.
  • Maintain rigorous controls appropriate for a highly regulated financial services environment.


Qualifications


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent in related field.
  • 20+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, technology delivery, and digital transformation.
  • 15+ years of leadership experience managing large engineering organizations.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex global technology organizations - prefer Bank's GCC.
  • Proven experience leading senior technology leaders, engineering managers, and architects.


Preferred Qualifications


Technology & Engineering

  • Strong background in software delivery, platform engineering, Dev/ML Ops, Site Reliability Engineering, and technology operations.

Banking & Financial Services

  • Experience supporting customer-facing digital channels and financial products.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory, risk, compliance, and security requirements within financial institutions.

Leadership

  • Exceptional ability to influence senior executives and drive outcomes without direct authority.
  • Demonstrated success in talent development, succession planning, and organizational transformation.
  • Strong executive presence with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

About Cornerstone:
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
About the role:
Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys.
As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You'll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you'll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal.
This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You'll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You'll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone's own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.
The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company's future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.
This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.
Scope and Decision Rights:
  • You own: Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
  • You partner on: enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).
In this role, you will...
Key Responsibilities:
Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management
  • Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
  • Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
  • Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
  • Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
  • Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.
Architecture & Standards
  • Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
  • Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
  • Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
  • Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.
AI-Powered Experiences
  • Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
  • Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
  • Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.

Integration & Execution

The Cyber Defense - Senior Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for strengthening the organization's ability to detect and validate cyber threats through SIEM detection engineering, proactive threat hunting, purple teaming, and adversary emulation. The role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of detection content - from requirements and design through testing, deployment, tuning, measurement, and retirement - and uses the MITRE ATTCK framework to align detections, hunts, and validation activities with relevant adversary behaviors. The Senior Analyst works closely with Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, and other technology and security teams to identify visibility and detection gaps, validate control effectiveness using CALDERA, VECTR, and other breach-and-attack simulation tools, and translate findings into measurable improvements. The role also provides technical guidance and mentoring while remaining primarily hands-on.

  • Use MITRE CALDERA, VECTR, and other breach-and-attack simulation tools to safely emulate relevant adversary behaviors, track test scenarios, record defensive outcomes, and validate detection and response controls.
  • Expertise in design, development, testing, deployment, tuning, and lifecycle management of high-fidelity SIEM detections across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, application, and other relevant telemetry sources.

title: Staff Software Engineer, SDKs & Open Source
jobDescription:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About the Team
Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service.
FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers.
Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models.


About the role
We're hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. You'll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language.
This is an individual contributor role. You'll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery


Responsibilities
Set the direction:
  • Define and drive the technical direction for FGA DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team.
  • Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community
  • Mentor the team's senior engineers, and raise the level of everyone around you.
  • Establish how a new team builds software, from design reviews and coding standards to how we test and ship, and set the quality bar.
  • Make the calls that are hard to undo: when an API is ready to ship across every language, how it evolves, and when to deprecate.
  • Be the voice of developer experience across FGA: partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it.
Own the Platform:
  • Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from.
  • Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting.
  • Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples.
  • Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions
  • Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute.


Requirements
  • 8+ years as a software engineer, including time leading the technical direction of a team or a significant area, with or without the title.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/.NET, Python or Java, and the curiosity to work across several.
  • Experience building software other developers use: SDKs, API clients, libraries, developer platforms, CLIs or tooling.
  • A strong sense of API design and ergonomics, and of how an interface should feel in different languages
  • Clear communication and a track record of influencing decisions across teams and with outside contributors, without relying on authority
Nice to have
  • Contributing to, maintaining or leading open source projects.
  • Building with code generation tools such as OpenAPI Generator and templating frameworks.
  • Designing resilient clients: authentication flows, retries and rate limiting.
  • Setting up GitHub Actions and release automation.
  • Working in authorization or identity, such as OAuth, RBAC or ReBAC .

title: Senior Lead, Capacity Building
jobDescription:
World Change Starts with Educated Children
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.


Job Summary
The Senior Lead, Capacity Building owns how Room to Read India builds the capability of its people and partners to improve childrens literacy learning outcomes. The person in this role will lead all literacy training across the organization and with government and partner systems: analyzing training needs at every level, designing role-specific training and materials, including virtual modules and courses, building competency frameworks that track individual learning over time, and measuring training impact jointly with the Research, Monitoring and Evaluation RME team, with improvement in Knowledge, Attitude and Practice KAP as the central measure. The Senior Lead also owns the quality standards that all literacy training must meet. This position will be based at the Country Office in New Delhi, report directly to the Senior Director, Programs, lead one Officer, work closely with the IDTS team, and require frequent travel to project locations and regular interaction with state teams, education officials, partners and training agencies.


About Instructional Design and Technical Support Team
The team enables RtRs state units to enhance program implementation by improving the adoption of structured pedagogy resources, teacher and team professional development, and evidence-informed assessment in instruction. The team is in charge of content creation amidst a lot of academic rigor and field experiences.This team supports other teams by providing technical inputs at various levels including internal and external stakeholders. It also leads Room to Read Indias work on INCO, an AI-powered literacy coaching app, ensuring the technology stays anchored in sound pedagogy and real classroom practice.


Responsibilities

Training Needs Analysis Across Levels
  • Conduct periodic training needs analysis across all levels of the organization.
  • Draw on program data, field observations, coaching and monitoring records, assessment results and consultations with Program and RME teams to identify capability gaps.
  • Translate needs into a prioritized, role-specific capacity-building plan aligned to program calendars, hiring phases and project goals.


Ownership of Literacy Training and Quality Standards
  • Lead the end-to-end literacy training architecture: induction, technical training on literacy pedagogy and program models, data-use training and mid-course correction training.
  • Sequence and coordinate training delivered by IDTS, other internal teams, external agencies and consultants, and oversee logistics, facilitators and batches across locations with Admin, Finance and Program teams.
  • Oversee training for government and partner systems (such as SCERT, DIET and partner organizations) where Room to Read supports capacity building.
  • Define and uphold quality standards for the design, delivery and follow-up of literacy training, observing sessions, reviewing facilitator performance and gathering participant feedback.
  • Document lessons from each training cycle, feed them into the next one, and share learning and recommendations with Program, Technical and Leadership teams.


Training Materials and Virtual Courses
  • Lead the design of training modules, facilitator guides, participant materials and job aids for literacy projects, including materials that help teams understand and use program data and run mid-course correction training when data shows implementation or learning gaps.
  • Design and manage a library of virtual training modules and courses for each role and level, with defined learning outcomes, duration, mode, content sequence, practice tasks and assessments.
  • Develop course content such as short videos, interactive lessons, case studies, classroom practice clips and quizzes, in Hindi, English and other languages the program needs.
  • Run a learning management system or equivalent platform with enrollment, completion tracking, certification and links to competency and Knowledge, Attitude and Practice KAP results, and plan virtual and blended delivery, including live online sessions, peer learning and offline or mobile-friendly formats for low-connectivity locations.
  • Ensure all materials are linked to childrens learning outcomes and reviewed with technical experts before roll-out; build and mentor a pool of internal facilitators and master trainers.


Competency Frameworks and Learning Tracking
  • Create a competency framework for each training area and role, with defined learning outcomes and observable indicators.
  • Design assessments, observation tools and rubrics so that each individuals understanding and practice can be measured and tracked over time.
  • Set minimum competency thresholds for trainees to begin contributing to the project as per role expectations, and define follow-up support (refreshers, coaching, reassessment) for trainees who have not met them.
  • Maintain learning records and a training dashboard that show progress by individual, role, cohort and project.


Training Impact Analysis with RME
  • Jointly with RME, design and carry out evaluations of training impact, with KAP improvement as the central measure.
  • Co-develop KAP baseline, post-training and follow-up tools, and agree sampling, timing and analysis methods with RME.
  • Link training participation and competency results to changes in field practice, program quality indicators and, where possible, childrens learning outcomes.
  • Co-author findings and recommendations with RME, and use them to revise training design, content and delivery for subsequent cohorts.


Qualifications

Required
  • Bachelors degree in Education, Social Sciences, Development Studies, Management or a related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in education or development programs, including substantial responsibility for training needs analysis and for planning and managing training across multiple cohorts, roles and locations.
  • Experience designing training materials and competency frameworks, with assessments or observation tools that track individual learning over time.
  • Experience measuring training effectiveness, including KAP assessments, and working with an ME or research team to use findings for improvement.
  • Strong understanding of literacy instruction and how adults and teachers learn; ability to link training to childrens learning outcomes.
  • Experience using program and learning data to diagnose implementation gaps and design corrective or refresher training.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Hindi and English.


Desirable
  • Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in education, training, or learning and development.
  • Experience in foundational literacy or large-scale government education programs, including work with systems such as SCERT and DIET.
  • Experience with multilingual education, or with digital and AI-supported coaching and learning tools.
  • Experience managing external training agencies

TL;DR
Spyne is launching AI agents that dealers can find, try and turn on themselves. As our founding growth lead, you\'ll own the funnel, the paid budget, the website and the automation behind them, and answer for 1 number: rooftops with an agent live.


Why This Role

What You'll Own

01. Own the funnel, end to end (Full-funnel growth)

  • Ship 10+ experiments a month across pricing pages, onboarding, trials and offers, with a written verdict on each.
  • Run the weekly growth review: what moved, why, and what ships next.


02. Turn spend into rooftops (Performance marketing)
Every dollar answers to an activated rooftop, not a click.
  • Run paid across every channel dealers use: Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and AI-assistant ads, with CAC and payback tracked per agent.
  • Prove what works with incrementality tests, not last-click attribution.
  • Own the creative loop: brief, produce, test, kill and scale, using agentic workflows to ship hundreds of variants a month with a human eye on quality.
  • Feed winners everywhere: what works in paid shapes the website, lifecycle and organic content.


03. Make the website and search sell for us (Web, SEO and AEO)

  • Run spyne.ai as a growth product: landing pages for every agent, role, DMS and OEM, with conversion tests always live.
  • Scale programmatic SEO and AEO with the content team, and earn citations in AI answers.
  • Build integration and comparison pages that convert dealers who are evaluating options.


04. Turn product usage into pipeline (Lifecycle and PLG to sales)
The rooftop that tries 1 agent becomes the dealer group that runs 6.
  • Build lifecycle across email, SMS and in-product that moves rooftops from signup to activation to expansion.
  • Define product-qualified leads with Sales and route them in minutes, not days.
  • Spot dealer-group signals in usage and hand them to the revenue team with full context.
  • Run referral loops that turn happy dealers into the next 10 signups.


05. Build the machine with AI (Growth ops and automation)
Automate the work before anyone hires for it.
  • Own enrichment, scoring, routing and follow-up on clean CRM data.
  • Build attribution from first touch to paid rooftop so marketing and sales trust the same numbers.
  • Ship agentic workflows with tools such as Claude, Clay and n8n for research, personalization, content and reporting.

06. Launch every agent and every market (Launches and international)
Each new agent and each new country gets a launch that hits its number.

How Well Measure You

Your First 90 Days

  • Day 60: paid and lifecycle live for 2 agents with CAC tracked.
  • Day 90: 30+ experiments shipped and a 2-quarter growth plan.


Who You Are
  • 4 to 7 years in growth marketing at a product-led SaaS or AI company, with a funnel and a paid budget you owned.
  • You can show the numbers: cohorts, CAC, payback and conversion, before and after your work.
  • You write SQL or get close, and you build your own dashboards.

title: Senior Lead, Capacity Building
jobDescription:
World Change Starts with Educated Children
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.


Job Summary
The Senior Lead, Capacity Building owns how Room to Read India builds the capability of its people and partners to improve childrens literacy learning outcomes. The person in this role will lead all literacy training across the organization and with government and partner systems: analyzing training needs at every level, designing role-specific training and materials, including virtual modules and courses, building competency frameworks that track individual learning over time, and measuring training impact jointly with the Research, Monitoring and Evaluation (RME) team, with improvement in Knowledge, Attitude and Practice (KAP) as the central measure. The Senior Lead also owns the quality standards that all literacy training must meet. This position will be based at the Country Office in New Delhi, report directly to the Senior Director, Programs, lead one Officer, work closely with the IDTS team, and require frequent travel to project locations and regular interaction with state teams, education officials, partners and training agencies.


About Instructional Design and Technical Support Team (IDTS)
The team enables RtRs state units to enhance program implementation by improving the adoption of structured pedagogy resources, teacher and team professional development, and evidence-informed assessment in instruction. The team is in charge of content creation amidst a lot of academic rigor and field experiences.This team supports other teams by providing technical inputs at various levels including internal and external stakeholders. It also leads Room to Read Indias work on INCO, an AI-powered literacy coaching app, ensuring the technology stays anchored in sound pedagogy and real classroom practice.


Responsibilities

Training Needs Analysis Across Levels
  • Conduct periodic training needs analysis across all levels of the organization.
  • Draw on program data, field observations, coaching and monitoring records, assessment results and consultations with Program and RME teams to identify capability gaps.
  • Translate needs into a prioritized, role-specific capacity-building plan aligned to program calendars, hiring phases and project goals.


Ownership of Literacy Training and Quality Standards
  • Lead the end-to-end literacy training architecture: induction, technical training on literacy pedagogy and program models, data-use training and mid-course correction training.
  • Sequence and coordinate training delivered by IDTS, other internal teams, external agencies and consultants, and oversee logistics, facilitators and batches across locations with Admin, Finance and Program teams.
  • Oversee training for government and partner systems (such as SCERT, DIET and partner organizations) where Room to Read supports capacity building.
  • Define and uphold quality standards for the design, delivery and follow-up of literacy training, observing sessions, reviewing facilitator performance and gathering participant feedback.
  • Document lessons from each training cycle, feed them into the next one, and share learning and recommendations with Program, Technical and Leadership teams.


Training Materials and Virtual Courses
  • Lead the design of training modules, facilitator guides, participant materials and job aids for literacy projects, including materials that help teams understand and use program data and run mid-course correction training when data shows implementation or learning gaps.
  • Design and manage a library of virtual training modules and courses for each role and level, with defined learning outcomes, duration, mode, content sequence, practice tasks and assessments.
  • Develop course content such as short videos, interactive lessons, case studies, classroom practice clips and quizzes, in Hindi, English and other languages the program needs.
  • Run a learning management system or equivalent platform with enrollment, completion tracking, certification and links to competency and Knowledge, Attitude and Practice (KAP) results, and plan virtual and blended delivery, including live online sessions, peer learning and offline or mobile-friendly formats for low-connectivity locations.
  • Ensure all materials are linked to childrens learning outcomes and reviewed with technical experts before roll-out; build and mentor a pool of internal facilitators and master trainers.


Competency Frameworks and Learning Tracking
  • Create a competency framework for each training area and role, with defined learning outcomes and observable indicators.
  • Design assessments, observation tools and rubrics so that each individuals understanding and practice can be measured and tracked over time.
  • Set minimum competency thresholds for trainees to begin contributing to the project as per role expectations, and define follow-up support (refreshers, coaching, reassessment) for trainees who have not met them.
  • Maintain learning records and a training dashboard that show progress by individual, role, cohort and project.


Training Impact Analysis with RME
  • Jointly with RME, design and carry out evaluations of training impact, with KAP improvement as the central measure.
  • Co-develop KAP baseline, post-training and follow-up tools, and agree sampling, timing and analysis methods with RME.
  • Link training participation and competency results to changes in field practice, program quality indicators and, where possible, childrens learning outcomes.
  • Co-author findings and recommendations with RME, and use them to revise training design, content and delivery for subsequent cohorts.

Required

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in education or development programs, including substantial responsibility for training needs analysis and for planning and managing training across multiple cohorts, roles and locations.
  • Experience designing training materials and competency frameworks, with assessments or observation tools that track individual learning over time.
  • Experience measuring training effectiveness, including KAP assessments, and working with an ME or research team to use findings for improvement.
  • Strong understanding of literacy instruction and how adults and teachers learn; ability to link training to childrens learning outcomes.
  • Experience using program and learning data to diagnose implementation gaps and design corrective or refresher training.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Hindi and English.
  • Willingness to travel frequently to project locations.


Desirable

  • Experience in foundational literacy or large-scale government education programs, including work with systems such as SCERT and DIET.
  • Experience with multilingual education, or with digital and AI-supported coaching and learning tools.
  • Experience managing external training agencies

jobDescription:
1. Position Summary
The Project Planning Controls Lead is responsible for providing planning leadership, schedule governance, and delivery assurance for data center construction and infrastructure projects delivered under a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) model.
Acting as the client's planning and controls representative, the role ensures that integrated master schedules, progress reporting, and forecasting frameworks are robust, accurate, and aligned with delivery objectives. The position works closely with Project Managers, Project Directors, contractors, consultants, and client stakeholders to provide clear, data-driven insights that support timely decision-making and delivery certainty across one or multiple mission-critical data center projects.


2. Key Responsibilities

Planning Controls Leadership
  • Lead planning and controls activities across the full project lifecycle, including design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.

Schedule Development Governance

  • Support phasing strategies, fast-track delivery, and concurrent construction models common to data center projects.


Progress Monitoring, Analysis Reporting

Risk, Change Recovery Planning

Delay Analysis, Claims Review Forensic Support

Contractor Consultant Coordination

About TRADL AI
TRADL AI is building Indias first AI-native trading platform for retail equity and F&O traders. We turn natural language into verified, code-backed market intelligence, and were now building our own broking stack so traders can research, decide and execute in one place.
Why This Role Exists
In broking, a bug is never just a bad screen. A wrong margin number, a stuck order or a P&L that doesnt match costs a trader real money and costs us their trust. As we take on order execution, every release needs someone who knows how a trade moves from the order screen to the exchange to the contract note, and who finds whats broken before our users do.
What Youll Own
  • Order flow testing: Every order type across equity and F&O, through placement, modification, partial fills, rejections and cancellations
  • Risk and margin checks: RMS validations, margin blocking, peak margin, freeze quantity, lot sizes and expiry-day behaviour
  • Positions, holdings and P&L: MTM, square-off and carry-forward, reconciled against back-office data and contract notes
  • Onboarding and funds: e-KYC, segment activation, pay-in, payout and ledger entries
  • Release sign-off: test plans, regression suites and the go/no-go call before every release across web, Android and iOS
  • Exchange and vendor UAT: exchange mock trading sessions, OMS vendor UAT, and checking our flows against new SEBI and exchange circulars
What Were Looking For
  • 3-4 years in manual QA, with hands-on testing at a stockbroker or trading platform is mandatory.
  • A solid grip on how Indian markets work: order types, F&O contracts, margins, T+1 settlement and corporate actions
  • Test cases a new teammate can run without coming back to you with questions
  • Comfort with Postman for API checks and basic SQL to verify data on the backend
  • Bug reports engineers can act on straight away: clear steps, expected vs actual, logs and screenshots in Jira or similar
  • Calm under live market hours. You know which bugs can wait till 3:30 and which cant
Bonus Points
  • You trade yourself
  • Some automation exposure (Selenium, Appium)

title: E-commerce Executive
jobDescription:
JOB DESCRIPTION
E-commerce Executive / Manager
Industry: Leather Bags, Handbags & Accessories Location: Kolkata
Department: E-commerce Employment Type: Full-time
  1. Job Purpose
We are looking for a responsible and result-oriented E-commerce Executive / Manager to manage and grow our online sales business for leather bags and accessories. The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day marketplace operations, inventory management, order processing, sales reporting, advertising coordination and profitability analysis.
The candidate should be comfortable working with marketplace dashboards, Excel and business reports, and should have a strong understanding of e-commerce operations.
  1. Key Responsibilities
    1. Marketplace Management
      • Manage day-to-day operations of Amazon seller accounts, particularly Amazon USA.
      • Monitor account health, order status, listing performance and marketplace notifications.
      • Ensure product listings are accurate, complete and up to date.
      • Coordinate product uploads, titles, descriptions, keywords, images and pricing updates.
      • Monitor suppressed listings, policy issues and account performance notifications.
      • Coordinate with marketplace support to resolve operational issues.
    2. Sales and Business Growth
      • Monitor daily, weekly and monthly sales performance.
      • Analyse sales by SKU, product category and marketplace.
      • Identify best-selling, slow-moving and underperforming products.
      • Recommend pricing, promotions and sales improvement initiatives.
      • Coordinate product launches and seasonal promotions.
      • Track sales targets and prepare performance reports.
    3. Inventory and Order Management
      • Maintain SKU-wise inventory records and reconcile stock with marketplace reports.
      • Monitor stock availability in Amazon fulfilment centres and the companys warehouse.
      • Identify stock-outs, excess stock and slow-moving inventory.
      • Coordinate replenishment with the manufacturing and warehouse teams.
      • Monitor order fulfilment, cancellations, shipment delays and inventory discrepancies.
      • Maintain accurate records of damaged, returned and unsellable stock.
    4. Returns, Refunds and Reimbursements
      • Monitor customer returns, refunds and return reasons.
      • Track returned inventory and coordinate physical inspection where applicable.
      • Identify eligible reimbursement claims for lost, damaged or incorrectly handled inventory.
      • Follow up on outstanding claims and maintain a claim tracker.
      • Analyse return trends and recommend corrective actions to reduce losses.
    5. Advertising and Marketing
      • Monitor Amazon advertising campaigns, budgets and performance.
      • Track advertising spend, attributed sales, ACoS and ROAS.
      • Coordinate with advertising agencies or specialists where required.
      • Recommend improvements to campaigns, product visibility and conversion rates.
      • Coordinate promotions, coupons and discounts within approved budgets.
    • Profitability and Financial Reporting
      • Prepare SKU-wise profitability reports.
      • Track selling price, product cost, marketplace fees, fulfilment charges, advertising expenses, refunds and other relevant costs.
      • Monitor marketplace settlements and reconcile payments with bank receipts.
      • Coordinate with the accounts team for recording transactions in Tally.
      • Prepare weekly sales and profitability summaries and monthly e-commerce P&L reports.
      • Identify loss-making products and recommend corrective measures.
    • Reporting and Coordination
      • Prepare daily, weekly and monthly e-commerce reports.
      • Maintain trackers for sales, inventory, returns, advertising and unresolved issues.
      • Coordinate with manufacturing, warehouse, logistics, marketing and accounts teams.
      • Highlight important business risks, pending decisions and financial discrepancies to management.
      • Use Excel and AI tools to improve reporting, analysis and operational efficiency.
  1. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  1. Achievement of sales targets.
  2. Improvement in contribution profit and SKU-wise profitability.
  3. Inventory accuracy and reduction in stock-outs.
  4. Timely order processing and reduction in avoidable cancellations.
  5. Control of advertising expenditure and campaign performance.
  6. Timely resolution of returns, claims and account issues.
  7. Accuracy and timeliness of daily, weekly and monthly reports.
  8. Marketplace account health and listing availability.
  9. Timely reconciliation of marketplace settlements.
Targets should be set according to the existing business baseline and reviewed monthly.
  1. Required Qualifications and Experience
  • Graduate in commerce, business administration, marketing or a related field.
  • Ideally 2-5 years of hands-on e-commerce experience.
  • Experience managing Amazon seller accounts is essential for an Amazon-focused role.
  • Experience with Amazon USA will be an advantage.
  • Strong knowledge of Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions and reporting.
  • Understanding of inventory management, marketplace fees, returns and seller settlements.
  • Ability to analyse sales data and identify business improvement opportunities.
  • Experience with Tally or other accounting systems is desirable.
  • Good communication, coordination and problem-solving skills.
  1. Personal Attributes
  • Detail-oriented and comfortable working with numbers.
  • Takes ownership of tasks and follows through without constant supervision.
  • Able to identify discrepancies and investigate their root causes.
  • Proactive in identifying opportunities to improve sales and profitability.
  • Honest, organised and comfortable reporting problems transparently.
  1. Reporting Structure
The position will report directly to the business owner or designated business head and coordinate with manufacturing, warehouse, marketing and accounts teams.
  1. Expected Deliverables
  • Daily sales and operations report.
  • Weekly SKU-wise sales, inventory and advertising report.
  • Weekly returns, reimbursement and settlement tracker.
  • Monthly SKU-wise profitability and e-commerce P&L report.
  • Monthly action plan to improve sales, control costs and increase profitability.
Important: The role is not limited to uploading products and processing orders. The candidate must understand the commercial side of e-commerce and help management make informed decisions based on sales, costs, inventory and profitability.

title: Staff Product Manager
jobDescription:
Overview

Are you ready for what s next, now

About the Role
The Staff Product Manager - Data & Analytics supports the definition and evolution of Apteans semantic data models and Analytics Packages across business domains and products. The role translates business processes, metrics, reporting requirements, and underlying product data into reusable semantic definitions that can support analytics and AI use cases. Working closely with domain SMEs, customers, Product, Data Engineering, and Architecture, this role drives requirements from discovery through definition, technical validation, and customer validation. The role requires a strong combination of product thinking, business analysis, analytics, and hands-on understanding of relational data and data modeling.
We need a candidate who sits with an ERP SME or business user, understand the business process; inspect the underlying data/schema; define the business entities/KPIs; map source concepts to the semantic model; write requirements detailed enough for Engineering; validate the implementation (reports, AI query, or Agent outputs) with SMEs/customers.
Knowledge:
Requires strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts, including relational data models, business entities and relationships, semantic modeling, analytical metrics/KPIs, and data transformation from operational systems into analytics-ready structures.
Requires the ability to understand business processes and reporting requirements and translate them into detailed data and semantic-model definitions. You must be comfortable analyzing source schemas, tables, fields, relationships, and existing reporting assets in partnership with Engineering and domain experts.
Requires working knowledge of product management and business analysis practices, including requirements definition, customer and SME discovery, prioritization, documentation, validation, and cross-functional product development.
Knowledge of enterprise software, ERP systems, modern cloud data platforms, BI tools, and AI-enabled analytics is preferred.
Complexity:
Works across multiple business domains, ERP/product schemas, and analytics use cases where business terminology, source data structures, and customer requirements may differ.
Translates sometimes ambiguous business questions and existing reporting requirements into standardized entities, measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and semantic definitions that can be reused across products and customers.
Balances standard product requirements against ERP-specific and customer-specific requirements and identifies where extensions to the governed model are required.
Works through dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, domain SMEs, Professional Services, customers, and other stakeholders to move semantic-model and Analytics Package work from discovery through validation.
This reflects the actual scope in the resourcing case: reusable semantic models are intended to span Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, Quality and other domains, with iteration occurring across ERPs and eventually non-Aptean systems.
Supervision:
Works with a high degree of independence within defined product priorities and objectives.
Receives strategic direction from the Director, Product Management - Analytics & Data Products and independently drives assigned semantic-model domains and Analytics Package workstreams.
Coordinates work across technical and business stakeholders but does not initially have direct people-management responsibility.
Escalates significant product, data, architecture, and prioritization decisions where broader alignment is required.
Principal Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Define business semantics and domain models.
  • Lead discovery with product SMEs, customers, and internal stakeholders to understand business processes, entities, relationships, terminology, business questions, metrics, and KPIs. Translate these inputs into detailed, reusable semantic-model requirements and domain definitions.
  • Analyze source data and define source-to-semantic mappings.
  • Work with Product and Data Engineering teams to understand existing products and ERP schemas, including relevant tables, fields, keys, relationships, and business logic. Define and document how source data maps to standardized business entities, dimensions, measures, and relationships within the semantic model, and identify gaps requiring transformation or extension.
  • Define Analytics Packages
  • Translate business questions, KPIs, reporting requirements, and semantic-model capabilities into reusable Analytics Packages across functional domains such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, and Quality. Define package requirements, measures, dimensions, reporting experiences, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.
  • Driving semantic-model requirements through Engineering
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering and Architecture to convert product requirements into implementable semantic-model capabilities. Clarify requirements, resolve data and business-rule questions, review model implementations against intended business semantics, identify gaps, and support prioritization through delivery.
  • Validate models and packages with customers and SMEs
  • Plan and conduct validation sessions with domain SMEs, customers, and implementation teams to confirm that semantic definitions, KPIs, business rules, and Analytics Packages accurately represent real-world processes and reporting needs. Convert validation findings into prioritized product requirements and model improvements.
  • Standardize capabilities across products and customers
  • Compare requirements and source structures across ERP products and customer environments to distinguish reusable business concepts from product- or customer-specific requirements. Help establish canonical definitions while identifying where governed extensions are necessary.
  • Maintain product artifacts and semantic-model documentation
  • Create and maintain clear product artifacts including business definitions, entity and relationship definitions, KPI specifications, source mappings, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision logs, Analytics Package specifications, and supporting documentation required by Engineering and downstream product teams.
  • Support analytics and AI product evolution
  • Use customer feedback, product usage, implementation learning, and emerging requirements to identify opportunities to improve semantic models and Analytics Packages. Support the evolution of the semantic layer as a governed business context for analytics, natural-language analytics, Analytics Agents, and broader AI and Decision Intelligence capabilities.
